title: SSH
help: SSH access for git clone, pull and push over SSH. GitHub/GitLab API plugins are separate.
Prepare on the host: ~/.ssh/config and your existing private key, or a running ssh-agent with SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
Keep keys on the host; do not put them in project folders, plugins/ or orcan.config.json. Orcan mounts ~/.ssh read-only.
Example ~/.ssh/config: Host github.com | User git | IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 (write each option on its own line).
Add the matching public key to your GitHub/GitLab account. Never share the private key.
Check yourself on the host: ssh -T git@github.com (or your GitLab hostname); confirm the server fingerprint before trusting it.
Check the container mount: orcan plugins doctor --plugin ssh. This does not test remote authentication.
